meta.title: Model panel
meta.description: Adds a Model panel to the sidebar's panel list under Automation tasks. It shows the live model configuration as a dashboard — every provider with its endpoint, protocol, models, and credential state; the current default model with one-click switching; each provider's current balance (official DeepSeek wallets, or a billing probe for OpenAI-compatible gateways); and a dedicated usage page that folds token usage out of this profile's session logs into daily totals, per-provider and per-model breakdowns, and an optional cost estimate from prices you configure. Providers can also be configured in the panel: add or remove a route, edit its protocol, endpoint, credential reference and API key, and edit the models the profile declares — the same write path Settings > Models uses, validated and guarded against concurrent changes.
